credential_pathway.name: Certificate in Problem Analysis & Solution Architecture

capabilities.name: Business Understanding
capabilities.description: Comprehending enterprise operational models, stakeholder incentives, and commercial mechanics.

capabilities.name: Evidence & Problem Framing
capabilities.description: Grounding insights in primary & secondary evidence, separating observations from unverified assumptions.

capabilities.name: Strategic Choice
capabilities.description: Evaluating strategic possibilities, WWHTBT barrier-to-belief testing, and defensible tradeoff selection.

capabilities.name: Execution Thinking
capabilities.description: Designing roadmap milestones, operational architectures, dependencies, and risk mitigations.

capabilities.name: Professional Communication
capabilities.description: Synthesizing executive proposals, persuasive board-ready narrative, and structured visual assets.

weeks.title: Discover the Real Problem
weeks.output_description: Comprehensive diagnostic dossier documenting root causes, system dependencies, and bounded problem framing.

quality_gate.name: Problem Framing Quality Gate
quality_gate.rule: No clear, bounded, evidence-supported problem = no progression to Week 2.

sessions.title: Business Context & Evidence
sessions.focus: Deconstruct the company brief, map revenue & operational drivers, and audit available evidence.
sessions.required_working_evidence: Company Context & Challenge Sheet; Evidence/Assumption/Unknowns Log (Initial Entries)

sessions.title: Problem Framing & Diagnosis
sessions.focus: Map workflows, pinpoint friction points, synthesize core 'How Might We' questions, and define measurable outcomes.
sessions.required_working_evidence: Workflow + Stakeholder Map; Problem Framing + Outcome Definition draft

sessions.title: Discovery Review
sessions.focus: Defend the Problem Framing Pack before your Dedicated Team Mentor & Facilitator. Formal progression gate.
sessions.required_working_evidence: Completed Business Diagnosis & Problem Framing Pack

templates.name: Company Context & Challenge Sheet
templates.description: Decode the company brief — map revenue model, operational drivers, and the commercial stakes of the challenge.

templates.name: Workflow + Stakeholder Map
templates.description: Visualise end-to-end workflows, identify friction points, and plot all stakeholders with their interests and influence.

templates.name: Evidence / Assumption / Unknowns Log
templates.description: Continuously track what you know (evidence), what you believe (assumptions), and what you still need to prove (unknowns).

templates.name: Problem Framing + Outcome Definition
templates.description: Synthesise root causes into a bounded, evidence-supported problem statement with measurable outcome targets.

weeks.title: Create Strategic Possibilities
weeks.strategic_question: What could we choose to do?
weeks.output_description: Comparative matrix of distinct strategic alternatives rigorously tested with What Would Have to Be True (WWHTBT) analysis.

quality_gate.name: Strategic Choice Quality Gate
quality_gate.rule: A preferred idea is not a strategic choice — team must show alternatives, assumptions, evidence and a defensible reason for choosing one direction.

sessions.title: Research & Possibility Generation
sessions.focus: Explore divergent possibilities across market models, technology vectors, and organizational capabilities.
sessions.required_working_evidence: Strategic Possibilities Canvas (3+ distinct strategic vectors)

sessions.title: What Would Have to Be True? (WWHTBT)
sessions.focus: Isolate critical assumptions across customers, company, competitors, and economics. Stress-test barriers to belief.

sessions.title: Strategic Choice Review
sessions.focus: Present selected strategic choice backed by evidence and alternative trade-off justifications.

weeks.title: Design the Strategy
weeks.strategic_question: If this is our choice, how will it actually work?
weeks.output_description: End-to-end architecture bridging chosen strategy with operational milestones, dependency maps, and risk controls.

quality_gate.name: Coherence Architecture Gate
quality_gate.rule: Problem → Choice → Strategy → Execution must form one coherent chain.

sessions.title: Integrated Strategy Choices
sessions.focus: Where to play, how to win, required capabilities, and supporting management systems.

sessions.title: Execution Architecture
sessions.focus: Translate strategy into phased release tracks, workstreams, resourcing models, and milestone targets.

sessions.title: Strategy Review
sessions.focus: Defend operational feasibility, risk mitigations, and systemic coherence across the entire stack.
sessions.required_working_evidence: Dependencies, Risks + Success Measures Log & Strategy Blueprint

weeks.title: Build the Case for Action
weeks.strategic_question: Why should the company believe us?
weeks.output_title: Executive Proposal, Company Presentation, Strategic Design Portfolio
weeks.output_description: Executive pitch deck, formal written proposal dossier, and master strategic design portfolio submitted for company shortlisting.

quality_gate.name: Final Discover Review & Shortlisting Gate
quality_gate.rule: Company shortlisting decision → entry into Validate phase.
quality_gate.evaluator: Company Challenge Owner & DegreeLabs Executive Jury

sessions.title: Proposal Architecture
sessions.focus: Structure the executive investment case, commercial rationale, and compelling narrative arc.

sessions.title: Executive Communication
sessions.focus: Deck design, rhetorical framing, objection handling, and pitch rehearsal with Specialist Mentors.

sessions.title: Final Discover Review
sessions.focus: Formal final presentation to Company Challenge Owner and DegreeLabs jury for Phase Gate Progression.
sessions.required_working_evidence: Final Executive Proposal + Pitch Deck + Strategic Design Portfolio

roles.description: Student fellows working collaboratively in teams of 5.
Guides weekly deliverables, checks progress, and provides core feedback.
Subject matter experts brought in for domain/technical depth as-needed.
Conducts cohort sessions, workshops, and enforces sprint rituals.
Industry sponsor defining the real challenge and evaluating final proposals.
Oversees cohort execution, standards, quality gates, and certification.
